intent: Apply the bridge invoke handler rebuild to the exact repo supplied by the operator. Preserve nodejs20.x runtime evidence and emit a receipt after target repo update and smoke validation.

files_to_apply.notes: Use handler content from payload 001 unless target repo already has a newer valid handler. Preserve auth, body limit, Lambda invoke, evidence_state response, and GET health path.
Use workflow from payload 001. Add target repo and runtime ARN metadata to receipt. If cloud deploy auth is unavailable, emit dry-run or access-blocked receipt only.
Ensure module mode and Lambda SDK dependency are present.

definition_of_done: Target repo TML-4PM/mcp-bridge-invoke-handler updated or explicit access failure receipt emitted.
GitHub Action exists and is wired to deploy on push to main.
Lambda runtime evidence includes operator-supplied runtime ARN.
Smoke evidence captured: HTTP 200, SQL ping rows, wrong-key 401.
Receipt written to receipts/runtime and audit path if available.

failure_protocol.error: If target repo is inaccessible from Pen or runner, emit ACCESS_BLOCKED receipt and do not mark complete.
failure_protocol.impact: Rebuild remains queued but not applied to target repo.
failure_protocol.rollback: No destructive action. Existing bridge remains live.
failure_protocol.next: Grant runner/Pen access to target repo or mirror repo into visible installation.
